title: Shared definitions for Top Five Movies content

slug.description: A filename without its extension: lowercase words joined by hyphens.

author.description: Filename of the author's page in content/authors/, without .md.

text.description: A non-empty single line of text.

markdown.description: Inline markdown. Hard line breaks (a trailing backslash) are allowed.

image.description: Filename of a picture in content/images/, never a path.

item_path.description: Section and filename of an item, e.g. reviews/the-hurricane.
